messages.content: You are a participant in a paid, anonymous public goods experiment. Your group has four people and remains the same for 18 periods. There are three versions, six periods each: NP has contributions only; PP adds peer punishment; DP adds majority voting on intended punishment. All three versions were explained before play. Each period, each person receives 20 monetary units (MU) and simultaneously contributes an integer from 0 to 20. Each person keeps the uninvested part and receives 0.4 times the sum of all four contributions. After contributing, everyone sees all current contributions, the common project return and pre-punishment incomes. In PP and DP, you simultaneously choose an integer from 0 to 10 MU for each of the other three people. Each MU spent costs you 1 MU and reduces its target's income by 3 MU. These three entries form one joint decision. In PP punishment is implemented. In DP you then see the aggregate intended punishment for each of the other three targets and vote yes or no on each; you cannot vote on your own punishment. At least two yes votes out of the other three people implement punishment against a target. Each punisher pays their intended amount for that target only if approved, regardless of their own vote. Voting is free. If a target's aggregate intended punishment is zero, the instructions require no. At the end of a period you receive feedback on punishment and earnings. One MU equals EUR 0.01, and total earnings are paid at the end; personal financial losses are ruled out, although period income can be negative. Anonymous player numbers are randomly reassigned each period; other_1, other_2, other_3 denote this screen's three other group members in input order. You have no identity information about them. Make the current decision and return only the requested JSON.

Each period, each person receives 20 monetary units (MU) and simultaneously contributes an integer from 0 to 20. Each person keeps the uninvested part and receives 0.4 times the sum of all four contributions. After contributing, everyone sees all current contributions, the common project return and pre-punishment incomes. In PP and DP, you simultaneously choose an integer from 0 to 10 MU for each of the other three people. Each MU spent costs you 1 MU and reduces its target's income by 3 MU. These three entries form one joint decision. In PP punishment is implemented. In DP you then see the aggregate intended punishment for each of the other three targets and vote yes or no on each; you cannot vote on your own punishment. At least two yes votes out of the other three people implement punishment against a target. Each punisher pays their intended amount for that target only if approved, regardless of their own vote. Voting is free. If a target's aggregate intended punishment is zero, the instructions require no. At the end of a period you receive feedback on punishment and earnings. One MU equals EUR 0.01, and total earnings are paid at the end; personal financial losses are ruled out, although period income can be negative. Anonymous player numbers are randomly reassigned each period; other_1, other_2, other_3 denote this screen's three other group members in input order. You have no identity information about them. Make the current decision and return only the requested JSON.

Voting is free. If a target's aggregate intended punishment is zero, the instructions require no. At the end of a period you receive feedback on punishment and earnings.
